Subject: Re: Demo next week — need to shift because of end-of-year blackout

Hi Rafael,

Quick heads-up — our executive team just locked in a company-wide blackout for the last two weeks of November to accommodate year-end audits and regional travel. We have the demo with your team scheduled for 25 Nov (live). Can we pause live sessions until the freeze is over and pick this back up in December? Procurement also needs additional time to get internal approvals, so pushing gives us breathing room.

We really want to see the end-to-end flow but will be on the go for the next ten days. Options that would work for us:
- Record the run-through and share a short video + Q&A thread (asynchronous)
- Move to the first full week of December (any morning slots PT)

Apologies for the late change. Please let me know what you recommend and how that affects timelines for our POC.

Thanks,
Jordan Price
VP, Platform Integrations
Acme Health

Jordan — thanks for the update and totally understand. Good news: we can accommodate a short pause without impacting the proposed POC milestones. A couple of options so we stay momentum-aware:

1) Asynchronous: I can record a concise 18–22 minute walkthrough (screen + voice) that covers the integration, latency/cost overview, and the data flow. We’ll drop it in Drive and follow up with a 30-min live Q&A the week of Dec 7.
2) Rotating live coverage: If you still want at least one live session before the freeze, we can shift the full demo to Wed 24 Nov and then record any deep dives. Otherwise we move to Dec 7–10 and keep the original playbook.

To make the pause low-friction for both teams, I’ve attached a short playbook for temporary demo coverage (demo-coverage-playbook.pdf) and I can send an updated calendar invite (acme-demo-invite.ics) with the December options.

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll record and share the walkthrough by EOD Monday (23 Nov) if you prefer asynchronous;
- If December live is preferred, pick two morning slots (PT) in the attached invite and I’ll lock them;
- I’ll flag the plan in HubSpot and add a note to the deal timeline so procurement sees the requested pause.

Which option do you prefer? I can also loop in our Solutions Engineer for the live Q&A.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
